findings.claim: `runnerCauseCode` only understands thrown values, so the two incidents whose cause is a non-thrown fixed enum — the reservation-release refusal (`released.reason`, a `PromptRefinerReservationRefusal`) and the literal `"intent_missing"` — are reported as `causeCode: "non_error_throw"`, discarding the one diagnostic code available on a release failure in a system that forbids retrying to find out.
findings.reproduction: In tests/promptRefinerShadowRunner.test.mjs replace the fixture's `release` with `async () => { events.push("release"); return { ok: false, reason: "reservation_not_found" }; }` and run `npm run test:prompt-refiner-shadow-live-adapter`. In the "a pre-intent failure releases once" case, the second incident (`context.phase === "reservation_release"`) has `error === "non_error_throw"` and `context.causeCode === "non_error_throw"`, and `"reservation_not_found"` appears nowhere in `JSON.stringify(world.incidents)` — even though that refusal union (lib/promptRefinerReservationAuthority.ts:41-48) is already a fixed content-free enum that the criterion's "고정 코드" allows. Expected: the refusal code reaches the incident.

findings.claim: The `failIncidentReporting` fixture option is defined but never set by any test, so the completion criterion that a failed incident delivery preserves the original error classification (lib/promptRefinerShadowRunner.ts:121-133) has code but no regression guarding it.
findings.reproduction: `rg -n "failIncidentReporting" tests/` returns only the fixture definition at line 164; no test passes the option. Adding `const world = fixture({ failBeforeIntentAt: 0, failIncidentReporting: true })` and asserting the rejection is still `PROMPT_REFINER_SHADOW_PRE_DISPATCH_FAILED` (and that the swallowing path is taken) closes it; removing the `try/catch` in `reportRunnerIncident` currently breaks no test.

verdict.nextAction: All three inherited findings are closed with verifiable mechanisms — every caught pre/post-dispatch, intent-missing, release-failure and terminal-write path reports a fixed content-free incident before responding, `reservation_expired` skips release and re-throws PROMPT_REFINER_SHADOW_DISPATCH_REFUSED (adapter propagates onDispatch throws, lib/promptRefinerShadowLiveAdapter.ts:269), and the route's static maxDuration literal is compared directly against PROMPT_REFINER_SHADOW_ROUTE_MAX_DURATION_SECONDS; merge as is and optionally carry the two recorded nits into a later cleanup.
